build_mpt_causal_lm: build an MPTForCausalLM model with tensor parallel layers and speculative decoding head for causal language modeling
build_mpt_model: build an MPTModel transformer with token and position embeddings, MPTBlock layers, and attention bias support
implement_multihead_attention: implement a MultiheadAttention module with flash triton or torch attention backends and optional QK layer normalization
implement_mpt_block: implement an MPTBlock with layer normalization, multihead attention, and GELU MLP feed-forward network with residual connections
implement_scaled_attention: implement scaled_multihead_dot_product_attention with causal masking, key padding, ALiBi bias, and past key-value caching
